author: theboxplymouth
title: OPPORTUNITY CALLOUT: ARTIST COMMISSION for Tides & Tales
content: OPPORTUNITY CALLOUT: ARTIST COMMISSION 🌊🎤📦 @take_a_part_uk are looking for an artist-producer (or collective) to lead 'Tides & Tales', a multidisciplinary arts and heritage project for the East End community of Plymouth, capturing the histories of the working class fishing and ocean working area through intergenerational practices. They are seeking support in co-creating a podcast series and a 'Living Museum' cabinet with the East End community of Plymouth. Funded by @heritagefunduk with support from The Box, this project captures the maritime heritage, oral histories, and contemporary stories of Plymouth’s East End - working directly alongside local residents and young lead producers from the Ocean City Influencers. Key Info: 💰 Total Commission: £16,000 (£12,000 artist fee @ £300/day for 40 days + £4,000 materials/production) 📍 Location: East End of Plymouth 🗓️ Delivery Window: November 2026 – March 2027 ⏳ EOI Deadline: Friday 23 October 2026 Requirements: 5+ years of socially engaged, collaborative practice High-quality audio/podcast production skills Experience in 3D design, fabrication, or curation for the mobile exhibition cabinet Applications from Black, Asian, and Ethnically Diverse artists are warmly welcomed and encouraged. Looking for a collaborator? Enquiries from artists who excel in one area (audio vs. physical design) and would like help matching with a partner are also welcomed. How to apply: Send your CV, a 2-page outline proposal, and work samples to kim@takeapart.org.uk by 23 October.

author: espoirschooloflife
title: WE ARE HIRING: STORYBOOK ILLUSTRATOR (Paid Project)
content: 🎨 WE ARE HIRING: STORYBOOK ILLUSTRATOR (Paid Project) Espoir School of Life is looking for a creative Storybook Illustrator who can capture the stories written about Espoir School of Life. Espoir School of Life is a non-profit organization that provides free, inclusive, and liberating education alongside holistic community development programs for underprivileged children and their families in Siargao. The stories are already written, and we now need an artist to bring these local narratives, community impacts, and grassroots projects to life through vibrant illustrations. ✨ How to Apply: If you want to help us bring these island narratives to life, please fill out our application form here: bit.ly/espoir-SI Be ready to share your: • Contact Information • Portfolio Link • Expected Rate/Project Quotation We can’t wait to see your work! 🌴✨
